ingress.candidate: Select the constituency you are standing in.
ingress.organization: Select the constituency your party is standing in. One constituency can be selected for each election; if your party stands in several, please contact support.

noElection.candidate: No election you can be nominated in is held in this constituency.
noElection.organization: No election your party can be nominated in is held in this constituency.

constituencies.severalKept: You have several nominations in this election. They are kept as they are; you can change their details in the next step.

contestantApp.nominations.deletePrompt: Delete this nomination? It is deleted at once. If you add it again, an administrator must confirm it before voters see it.

description.candidate: These are the constituencies where you're nominated. If the election list or election symbol are missing, they will be automatically added later when candidate lists are confirmed.
description.organization: These are the constituencies where your party is nominated. If the election symbol is missing, it will be added later by the administrator.

descriptionEditable.candidate: These are your nominations. You can change them, and add your election number and list, until nominations are closed.
descriptionEditable.organization: These are your party’s nominations. You can change them, and add its election symbol and alliance, until nominations are closed.

details.confirmedNote: This nomination is confirmed. If you change it, an administrator must confirm it again, and voters do not see it until then.
details.ingress: Check the details of each nomination. Nothing is saved until you continue.
details.newNote: This nomination is new. An administrator must confirm it, and voters do not see it until then.
details.removedConfirmedNote: This nomination is confirmed and will be removed when you continue. A new one would have to be confirmed again.
details.removedNote: This nomination will be removed when you continue.

symbolInfo.candidate: Optional. Your number on the ballot, if you have one. At most 50 characters.
symbolInfo.organization: Optional. Your party’s symbol or number on the ballot, if it has one. At most 50 characters.
